verses.text: Ix yalanxi winhaj Moisés t'a heb' chonhab' israel icha tik:
Ayxo 120 ab'il in k 'inal, manhxa wal wip in b'eyek' ex in kuchb'ej, hanhejtona' toxo ix yal Jehová t'ayin to manhxo ol in k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán tik.

Palta a Jehová ol b'ab'lajnhej t'a eyichanh, ol satanel masanil juntzanh chonhab' ayek' b'aj ol ex k'och chi'. Ha exxo ol ex kajnajkan t'a slum heb'. Haxo winhaj Josué ol ex kuchb'anok, icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'ayex.
Ha Jehová chi' ol satanel heb' anima t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', icha ix aj satanel heb' winh sreyal amorreo, haton winhaj Sehón yet' winhaj Og yet' heb' yetchonhab' heb'.
Ha ol ak'anoch juntzanh nación chi' t'a yol he k'ab', ol he satanel heb' icha ix aj walan t'ayex.

Tek'b'ejek he b'a, manh ex xiwok ayik ol he chalan he b'a yet' heb' ajk'ol chi', yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ayoch heyet'ok. Manh he na' to ol ex aktajkan yuj, manh ol ex yak'kanlaj he ch'okoj, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Josué chi' winh. T'a yichanh masanil heb' chonhab' israel ix yal winh t'a winh icha tik: Tza tek'b'ej wal a b'a, manh ach xiwok, yujto a ach ol ik'b'at jun chonhab' tik t'a sat lum lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'a heb' ko mam kicham. Ha ach ol ak'kan junjun makan heb' t'a smakb'en.
Ha Jehová ol b'ab'laj u'uj. Aynhejek' het'ok, manh ol ach yaktejkanlaj, yuj chi' manh ach xiwok, manh ach meltzaj t'a a patik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a winh.

Ix stz'ib'an juntzanh tik winhaj Moisés chi', ix yak'ankan winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sacerdote yinhtilal Leví tz'ik'anb'at skaxa'il strato Jehová yet' t'a masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ayik slajwi yuktakil ab'il, t'a yol ab'il yik slajwikan b'ok, ayik molanek' masanil anima t'a yichanh Jehová t'a jun lugar sik'b'ilel yuj t'a juntzanh sk'uhal k'inh chinama, hata' tz'awtaj ley tik yab' masanil anima.

Smolb'ej sb'a masanil anima, heb' winh winak, heb' ix ix yet' heb' kotak unin yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal. Tze molb'ej he b'a yuj eyab'ani yet' eyojtakanel masanil tas syal jun ley tik, yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová ko Diosal t'a yol he sat, yik tze k'anab'ajan tas syala'.

Icha pax chi' heb' eyinhtilal manto ojtannakok jun ley tik, ol yab'kan heb' yik wach' ay yelk'och Jehová chi' t'a yol sat heb' t'a masanil tiempo t'a sat lum lum ol eyikej t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán tik, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Wanxo sk'och stiempo'al yik ol ach chamok. Yuj chi' awtejkot winhaj Josué, tzex b'at t'a in kajnub' b'aj tzin ch'ox in b'a yik wach' ol wak'kanoch yopisio winh, xchi t'a winh. Ix b'at winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Josué chi'.
Hata' ix sch'ox sb'a Jehová chi' t'a heb' winh t'a skal jun niwan asun ix och moyan t'a sti' kajnub' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik: Ha ach tik toxo ol ach chamok. Slajwi chi', a jun chonhab' tik ol ochkan tzak'an heb' yuj juntzanh yechel skomon diosal juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a spatik yichanh b'aj ol k'och heb'. Ol in yaktejkan heb', ol yixtanb'at in trato heb' ix in b'o yet'ok.

Yuj chi', ol kot wowal t'a heb', ol waktankan heb' sch'okoj. Manhxo ol wab' tas ol yal heb'. Manhxo jantakok yahelal ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb', masanto ol yal heb' icha tik: ¿Tas wal yuj skab' sya'il? Yuj am to manhxo ayok ek' ko Diosal t'a ko kal, xcham heb'.
Ayik ol yab'an juntzanh yahelal chi' heb', ol wik'el in b'a t'a skal heb' yuj masanil chukal sk'ulej, yuj pax to tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel chi'.
Ha tikne'ik jun, tz'ib'ejek jun b'it ol wal t'ayex, ol he k'ayb'an heb' eyetchonhab' Israel tik t'ay, ol sb'itan heb' yik swak'och testigo'al t'a yib'anh heb'.

Ayik ol lajwok wik'anoch heb' anima tik t'a sat lum lum te yax sat chi', lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb' he mam eyicham, ol wa heb' sik'lab'il, ol b'ak'echb'ok heb'. Ol lajwok chi', ol b'at heb' t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios. Ol och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh chi'. Ol in spatikanel heb', ol yixtanb'at in trato heb' in b'onak yet'ok.

Ayik ol jawok jantak yahelal yet' ilk'olal t'a yib'anh heb', a jun b'it tik ol ak'an testigo'al t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo heb' yinhtilal heb' ol na'ankot jun b'it tik, ol sb'itan heb'. Yujto ayik manto ochlaj heb' t'a lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'a heb', wojtakxo tas ayek' t'a spensar heb', xchi Jehová chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix stz'ib'ejkan jun b'it tik winhaj Moisés, ix yak'an winh sk'ayb'ej heb' yetisraelal.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué, yuninal winhaj Nun icha tik: Tza tek'b'ej wal a b'a, manh ach xiwok, yujto ayinnhej och het'ok. Ha ach ol ik' och heb' etisraelal tik t'a sat lum lum wak'nak in ti' wak'an t'ayex, xchi t'a winh.
Ixlajwi stz'ib'ankan masanil juntzanh ley chi' winhaj Moisés chi',
ix yalan winh t'a heb' yinhtil Leví et'jinak skaxa'il strato Jehová icha tik:
Ik'ekb'at jun tz'ib'ab'il tik, tzeyak'anoch t'a stz'ey skaxa'il strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik syak' testigo'al t'a eyib'anh.
Yujto wojtak to te pit ex, malaj he gana sk'exwi he pensar. Ayik ayinto ek' heyet'ok, te pitnhej tzeyutej he b'a, okxom wal ol in chamok.
Awtejek heb' yichamtak winakil junjun eyinhtilal yet' heb' yajalil chonhab', yik swalankanel jun b'it tik t'a heb'. Swak'anoch satcha'anh yet' sat lu'um tik testigo'al.

Wojtakxo to ayik ol in chamok ol eyixtankanb'at he b'a, ol eyaktankan jun b'e b'aj tzex wak'kanoch tik. Hanhejtona' wojtakxopaxi to ha t'a b'ak'inh, ol jawok yahelal t'a eyib'anh, yujto ol he tzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Jehová yuj chukal ol he k'ulej t'a yichanh, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix och ijan winhaj Moisés yalan masanil slolonelal jun b'it tik t'a yichanh heb' chonhab' icha tik:
